method.model_residency: one load and one off-panel warmup per phase
method.warm_seconds: CUDA-synchronized model-specific input preparation, inference and required reconstruction. Excludes top-level model loading and final output file writes.
method.case_wall_seconds: CUDA-synchronized wall time of the resident per-case call with output serialization and per-model checks.
method.model_load_timing: Engine initialization and checkpoint load reported separately.
method.scoring: Run after all model phases and exclude from inference timings.
method.lasermpnn: Sum upstream per-batch preprocessing, inference and required side-chain reconstruction. Output CA verifies against official idealization.
method.adflip: Includes required iterative side-chain packing, parser audits and intermediate structure I/O.
